_readme: The currencies an advisor can add to a Three-Way Forecast's "Currencies you trade in"
table (item 13.5, drawing approved by Mike 2026-09-26). Codes only: each name is shown
in the reader's own language by the browser, so no English is held here.
SEPARATE FROM data/currencies.json ON PURPOSE. That file is the currencies a FIRM may
report in, and adding one there would offer it as a firm's own currency. A supplier
invoicing in Chinese yuan says nothing about what the firm reports in.
